"""
Project Title: Neural Cellular Automata for Self‑Organizing Pattern Growth (ai-ml-ds-NCAOrganism2025)
File Name: neural_cellular_automata_for_pattern_growth.py

Short Description:
Implements a Neural Cellular Automaton (NCA) in Keras that learns local update rules to grow arbitrary 32×32 target patterns (e.g., MNIST digits).
The NCA state has multiple channels; at each step, a small CNN observes the neighborhood and predicts cell-channel updates.
Training uses random seeds and an L2 loss on the target pattern after a fixed number of steps.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras.datasets import mnist  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# 1. Hyperparameters & Setup
# ----------------------------
SEED: int = 123
np.random.seed(SEED); tf.random.set_seed(SEED)
IMG_SIZE: int = 32           # type: int = canvas size
CHANNELS: int = 16           # type: int = state channels
TARGET_CHANNEL: int = 0      # type: int = which channel holds pattern
STEP_COUNT: int = 64         # type: int = NCA evolution steps
BATCH_SIZE: int = 8          # type: int = batch size
LR: float = 1e-3             # type: float = learning rate
EPOCHS: int = 5000           # type: int = training epochs
LOG_DIR: str = "./nca_logs"
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Load & preprocess MNIST targets
# ----------------------------
(x_train, _), _ = mnist.load_data()
# choose 8 target digits and resize to 32x32
targets: np.ndarray = tf.image.resize(
    x_train[:8,...,None]/255.0, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE)
).numpy()[...,0]  # shape (8,32,32)
targets: np.ndarray = (targets > 0.5).astype("float32")  # binarize

# ----------------------------
# 3. NCA Model Components
# ----------------------------
# Perceive layer: fixed Sobel filters + identity
SOBEL_X = np.array([[1,0,-1],[2,0,-2],[1,0,-1]],dtype="float32")/4
SOBEL_Y = SOBEL_X.T
KERNELS = np.stack([SOBEL_X, SOBEL_Y, np.zeros((3,3),float)],-1)
KERNELS = np.repeat(KERNELS[...,None,:], CHANNELS, axis=2)  # shape(3,3,CHANNELS,3)
PERCEIVE = layers.Conv2D(
    filters=CHANNELS*3,
    kernel_size=3,
    padding="same",
    use_bias=False,
    trainable=False,
    name="perceive"
)

# Build perceive weights
PERCEIVE.build((None,IMG_SIZE,IMG_SIZE,CHANNELS))
PERCEIVE.set_weights([np.transpose(KERNELS,(0,1,3,2))])

# Update network: small CNN on perceived features
upd_in = Input((IMG_SIZE,IMG_SIZE,CHANNELS*3))
x = layers.Conv2D(128,1,activation="relu")(upd_in)
dx = layers.Conv2D(CHANNELS,1,activation=None)(x)
UPDATE_NET = Model(upd_in, dx, name="update_net")

# Full NCA step
def nca_step(x):
    y = PERCEIVE(x)
    dx = UPDATE_NET(y)
    return x + dx * 0.1  # scale update

# ----------------------------
# 4. Training Loop
# ----------------------------
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)

@tf.function
def train_step(x, target):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        for _ in range(STEP_COUNT):
            x = nca_step(x)
        pred = x[...,TARGET_CHANNEL]
        loss = tf.reduce_mean(tf.square(pred - target))
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, UPDATE_NET.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, UPDATE_NET.trainable_variables))
    return x, loss

# Initialize random seeds for each pattern in batch
def init_states(batch_size: int):
    s = np.zeros((batch_size,IMG_SIZE,IMG_SIZE,CHANNELS),dtype="float32")
    # place seed at center
    center = IMG_SIZE//2
    s[:,center,center,TARGET_CHANNEL] = 1.0
    return s

# Training
for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    # sample batch of target indices
    idx = np.random.randint(0, targets.shape[0], BATCH_SIZE)
    target_batch = targets[idx,...]  # shape (B,32,32)
    x = init_states(BATCH_SIZE)
    x_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(x)
    x_final, loss = train_step(x_tf, target_batch)
    if epoch % 500 == 0:
        tf.print(f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS}, Loss: {loss:.6f}")

# ----------------------------
# 5. Example Use Cases
# ----------------------------
# Grow and display two examples
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # type: ignore
for i in [0,1]:
    x = init_states(1)
    x_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(x)
    for _ in range(STEP_COUNT):
        x_tf = nca_step(x_tf)
    out = x_tf[0,...,TARGET_CHANNEL].numpy()
    plt.subplot(1,2,i+1)
    plt.title(f"Target {i}")
    plt.imshow(targets[i], cmap="gray")
    plt.axis("off")
    plt.subplot(1,2,i+3)
    plt.title(f"Generated {i}")
    plt.imshow((out>0.5).astype("float32"), cmap="gray")
    plt.axis("off")
plt.show()

Key Learnings & Research Areas:

  • Neural Cellular Automata (NCA): local-update, self‑organizing systems.
  • Sobel-based perception: fixed convolutional filters for neighborhood sensing.
  • Trainable update network: learning local rules to grow global patterns.
  • Applications: procedural content generation, self‑healing networks, morphogenesis.

This NCA project leverages local dynamics to learn complex pattern growth—pushing Keras into emergent computation and self‑organizing systems!
